access.dst_inactive: The target device is disabled or frozen; it is not defined on the server.
access.free_between_devices: No access profile: devices can reach each other freely inside the VPN.
access.host_decides: No access profile: the server's own firewall (ufw) decides for server ports.
access.isolated_between_devices: No access profile: this device reaches only the server. Give it a profile to open access to other devices.
access.panel_open: The panel port is open to devices without an access profile.
access.ping_open: Ping to the server is always allowed.
access.policy_no_rule: The profile “{policy}” has no rule that allows this connection.
access.policy_off_window: The profile “{policy}” allows it, but it is outside the time window right now: {rule}
access.same_device: Source and target are the same device.
access.src_inactive: The source device is disabled or frozen; it is not defined on the server.
